subject: Life Skills
title: The Urgency Trick
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Urgency Trick.

hook.text: The email said 'Your account will be locked in 2 hours.' She clicked the link without thinking. Scammers won.

buildup.text: Urgency is the number one weapon in fraud. It bypasses your rational brain and triggers panicked, impulsive action.

discovery.text: Legitimate companies rarely impose two-hour deadlines via email. Real urgency comes with a phone call and verification.

twist.text: Scammers know that if you pause for even 10 minutes, you will see through it. The pressure is the product.

climax.text: Make this your rule: any message demanding immediate action gets a 10-minute pause. Contact the company directly.

punchline.text: If it demands urgency, that is the red flag.

quiz.question: Why do scammers use urgency in their messages?
options: Because urgent matters are always legitimate
To bypass rational thinking and trigger impulsive action
Because email providers flag slow messages as spam
